q.t: A cylinder just encloses a sphere of the same radius. Find the ratio of the sphere’s surface area to the cylinder’s curved surface area.
q.e: Cylinder: 2πr × 2r = 4πr², the same as the sphere.

q.e: Volumes are in the ratio of the cubes of the radii: 4³ : 1³.

q.e: With h = r: ⅓πr³ : ⅔πr³ : πr³.

q.e: The water displaced equals the sphere’s volume: (4/3)π × 27 = π × 36 × rise.
